creations.title: ACE Wind Now
creations.creator: charlie9578
creations.summary: A calm community turbine card showing instantaneous power and wind speed from the one-second feed, with a timestamp and clear stale or unavailable states.
creations.imageAlt: ACE Wind Now card with a green turbine illustration, live power in kW and wind speed in m/s from the one-second feed, a recent-reading badge, and the oldest signal observation time.
creations.dataUse: Uses ACE wec-1 wec_instantaneous latest 1s power and wind speed; refreshes every second; marks signal observations over one minute old stale and retains the last reading if the API is unavailable.

creations.title: Turbine Vortex
creations.creator: charlie9578
creations.summary: Fly through a circular turbine wake: three rotating blades shed luminous trails, wind sets the pace, power sets colour, and changes against a 30-second power average drive brightness. Layers remember the recent data.
creations.imageAlt: Circular Turbine Vortex with three rotating blades and bright tip trails, measured wind and power, a visible data-history time span and a signed power difference against its rolling 30-second mean.
creations.dataUse: Uses ACE wec-1 instantaneous 1s rotor speed, wind speed, power and wind-vane angle together every two seconds; data-time freshness and 30-second relative power brightness; shows visible history span and rests if signals stall over 60 seconds or fail.
